description:
Retype issue ids in the repository-state mutation, index, archive and materialization code.

## Background

`repository_state/mutation.rs` holds 29 production issue-id references, 3 raw-id signatures and two id-carrying fields. `repository_state/archive.rs` and `repository_state/materialize.rs` carry ids of archived and materialized issues.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No struct field, enum field or function parameter under `crates/jit/src/repository_state/` holds an issue id as `String`, `&str` or `Vec<String>`; each uses `IssueId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Issue, index, event and gate-run JSON written by mutations is byte-identical before and after.
- [hard] REQ-03: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.

## Notes

`crate::domain::identity::IssueId` is at this point an alias for `String`, and the `IssueIdStaging` trait gives it `short_id()`. Retyping to the alias is compiler-neutral, so this change is checked by its criteria rather than by type errors; a later change replaces the alias with the validated newtype and the compiler then reports any site missed here. Parameters are retyped outside-in: the CLI and server entry points already resolve ids, and callers in this family are retyped before the functions they call in inner layers.
title: Repository-state mutations carry typed issue ids
